units.source_text: “小宠犬毕竟是硬毛小猎犬啊！

en.t: After all, even a little pet dog is still a wire-haired hunting terrier!

units.source_text: 不妨想想，骑着马，率领数十条、数百条猎狗围猎狐狸，

en.t: Just imagine riding on horseback, leading dozens or even hundreds of hounds to hunt foxes,

units.source_text: 这种极其贵族式的游艺，光想想都觉得何等气派呀！”

en.t: such an utterly aristocratic pastime feels splendidly grand even just to think about!"
